text: 躲得过初一，躲不过十五
pinyin: duǒ de guò chū yī, duǒ bù guò shí wǔ
literal: dodge · can · past · first · day, dodge · cannot · past · fifteenth
natural: You can dodge the 1st of the month, but not the 15th

meaning.en: A problem you cannot avoid forever will catch up with you sooner or later.
meaning.zh: 一时躲过去了，终究躲不过，迟早要面对。

equivalents: You can run but you can't hide
What can't be cured must be endured

examples.zh: 债主天天找上门，躲得过初一，躲不过十五。
examples.en: The creditor comes round every day; you may dodge him today but not forever.

examples.zh: 早点去检查吧，躲得过初一，躲不过十五。
examples.en: Go and get checked soon; you can't avoid it forever.

usage.en: The image is of dodging debt collectors who came on set days of the month.
usage.zh: 形象来自旧时债主按日子上门讨债。

text: 过了这个村就没这个店
pinyin: guò le zhè gè cūn jiù méi zhè gè diàn
literal: pass · -ed · this · village · then · no · this · inn
natural: Once you pass this village there will be no inn like this

meaning.en: Seize the chance now, because it may not come again.
meaning.zh: 机会难得，错过了就不会再有，要抓紧。

equivalents: Strike while the iron is hot

examples.zh: 今天打五折，过了这个村就没这个店，赶紧买吧！
examples.en: Everything is half price today, and you won't get this chance again, so buy now!

examples.zh: 这个机会难得，过了这个村就没这个店。
examples.en: It's a rare opportunity; if you pass it up, there won't be another.

usage.en: Common in sales patter and in urging people to decide quickly.
usage.zh: 常见于促销和催人尽快做决定。

text: 酒不醉人人自醉，色不迷人人自迷
pinyin: jiǔ bú zuì rén rén zì zuì, sè bù mí rén rén zì mí
literal: wine · not · intoxicate · people · people · themselves · get drunk, beauty · not · bewitch · people · people · themselves · get bewitched
natural: Wine doesn't make people drunk; they get drunk themselves. Beauty doesn't bewitch; people bewitch themselves

meaning.en: Temptation has no power by itself; people fall for it of their own accord.
meaning.zh: 诱惑本身并不能让人沉迷，是人自己甘愿沉溺其中。

equivalents: The devil can't make you do it
It's the drinker, not the drink

examples.zh: 酒不醉人人自醉，色不迷人人自迷，关键还是自己要把持住。
examples.en: Wine doesn't make you drunk and beauty doesn't bewitch you; you do it to yourself, so you must keep control.

examples.zh: 他说是被人带坏的，可酒不醉人人自醉，色不迷人人自迷，还是自己的问题。
examples.en: He claims he was led astray, but people choose to get drunk; it's his own responsibility.

usage.en: Often used to explain that responsibility lies with the person who gives in. Also used romantically to describe being captivated.
usage.zh: 常用来说明责任在于自己；也可用于形容人自愿沉醉。

pinyin: jiǔ féng zhī jǐ qiān bēi shǎo
literal: wine · meet · bosom friend · thousand · cups · few
natural: With a bosom friend, a thousand cups are too few

meaning.en: When friends who understand each other drink together, no amount feels enough; they enjoy each other's company.
meaning.zh: 与知心朋友饮酒畅谈，喝多少都觉得不够。

equivalents: Good company makes the evening fly
Wine with a friend never runs dry

examples.zh: 酒逢知己千杯少，今晚咱们不醉不归！
examples.en: A thousand cups are too few with a close friend, so tonight we don't go home until we're drunk!

examples.zh: 多年没见，酒逢知己千杯少，我们聊到了深夜。
examples.en: We hadn't met for years, and with such a good friend we talked until late at night.

usage.en: Usually followed by 话不投机半句多 (with the wrong company, half a sentence is too much). Said at drinking tables.
usage.zh: 常与“话不投机半句多”连用，多用于酒桌。

text: 丑媳妇早晚也得见公婆
pinyin: chǒu xí fù zǎo wǎn yě děi jiàn gōng pó
literal: ugly · daughter-in-law · sooner · later · also · must · meet · parents-in-law
natural: Even an ugly daughter-in-law must meet her in-laws sooner or later

meaning.en: What you fear to show or face cannot be put off forever; sooner or later you must face it.
meaning.zh: 该来的总要来，再怕见人、怕面对的事也得面对。

equivalents: Sooner or later you have to face the music

examples.zh: 作品再不完美，丑媳妇早晚也得见公婆，下周就交稿吧。
examples.en: However imperfect the work is, you can't hide it forever, so hand it in next week.

examples.zh: 丑媳妇早晚也得见公婆，这件事瞒不了多久。
examples.en: Sooner or later you must face them; this can't be hidden for long.

usage.en: Self-mocking and humorous, said when about to show something imperfect. 媳 is read xí; 媳妇 xí fu.
usage.zh: 自嘲、诙谐，多用于要把不够完美的东西拿出来见人时。

synonyms: 躲得过初一，躲不过十五

text: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝
pinyin: jīn wō yín wō bù rú zì jǐ de gǒu wō
variants: 金窝银窝，不如自己的草窝
literal: gold · nest · silver · nest · not as good as · own · 's · dog · kennel
natural: A golden or silver nest is no match for your own doghouse

meaning.en: No luxurious place feels as comfortable as your own home, however humble.
meaning.zh: 别处再豪华，也比不上自己的家住着舒服自在。

examples.zh: 出差住了五星酒店，还是觉得金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。
examples.en: I stayed at a five-star hotel on the business trip, but there's still no place like home.

examples.zh: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝，早点回家吧。
examples.en: There's no place like home; come back early.

usage.en: Warm and humorous. Often said after travelling or when declining to move in with others.
usage.zh: 亲切诙谐，常在出门回家后或婉拒寄居别处时说。

pinyin: tiě dǎ de yá mén, liú shuǐ de guān
literal: iron · forged · 's · office, flowing · water · 's · officials
natural: The office is made of iron, but the officials flow past like water

meaning.en: Institutions endure while the officials in them come and go.
meaning.zh: 衙门是长久的，当官的却像流水一样换来换去。

equivalents: Men may come and men may go, but the institution goes on

examples.zh: 铁打的衙门，流水的官，政策不能因领导换了就变。
examples.en: Offices remain while officials come and go, so policy shouldn't change with every new leader.

examples.zh: 他们说铁打的衙门，流水的官，所以不太在意新领导。
examples.en: They say officials come and go while the office remains, so they pay little attention to the new boss.

usage.en: Often cynical; sometimes also used of companies and schools where staff turn over. Usually paired with 铁打的营盘流水的兵 in the army.
usage.zh: 常带调侃，也用于公司、学校等人员流动的场合；军营里有类似说法“铁打的营盘流水的兵”。

pinyin: yán wáng hǎo jiàn, xiǎo guǐ nán chán
literal: King of Hell · easy · to see, minor · demons · hard · to deal with
natural: The King of Hell is easy to meet, but his imps are hard to deal with

meaning.en: The top boss is often easier to deal with than the petty underlings who obstruct you.
meaning.zh: 大人物好说话，下面办事的小人物反而更刁难。

equivalents: It's the clerks, not the king, who make trouble

examples.zh: 老板很爽快就批了，可阎王好见，小鬼难缠，各部门盖章才麻烦。
examples.en: The boss approved it quickly, but the underlings are the real problem, and getting stamps from each department is a hassle.

examples.zh: 阎王好见，小鬼难缠，办这个证件我跑了五趟。
examples.en: It's the petty officials who make things hard; I went five times to get this certificate.

usage.en: Complains about obstructive low-level staff and bureaucracy. 难缠 is the usual form; 难当 is a variant.
usage.zh: 多用来抱怨基层办事人员刁难、手续繁琐。

text: 饱暖思淫欲，饥寒起盗心
pinyin: bǎo nuǎn sī yín yù, jī hán qǐ dào xīn
literal: full · warm · think · lust, hungry · cold · rise · thief · heart
natural: When well fed and warm one thinks of pleasure; when hungry and cold one turns to theft

meaning.en: People's behaviour is shaped by their circumstances: comfort breeds indulgence and hardship breeds crime.
meaning.zh: 人的行为受处境影响：生活安逸容易放纵，饥寒交迫容易铤而走险。

equivalents: Poverty breeds crime, comfort breeds vice
Hunger drives the wolf from the wood

examples.zh: 饱暖思淫欲，饥寒起盗心，要减少犯罪，先要改善民生。
examples.en: Comfort breeds indulgence and hunger breeds theft; to reduce crime, people's livelihood must come first.

examples.zh: 饱暖思淫欲，饥寒起盗心，这话虽然偏激，也有几分道理。
examples.en: Though extreme, there is some truth in saying that comfort breeds vice and hunger breeds theft.

usage.en: Sometimes quoted in social commentary; the first half is somewhat negative about human nature.
usage.zh: 常用于社会评论，前半句对人性带有贬义。

pinyin: yǒu qíng rén zhōng chéng juàn shǔ
literal: have · feeling · people · finally · become · married couple
natural: Lovers will finally become husband and wife

meaning.en: Those truly in love will eventually be united in marriage.
meaning.zh: 相爱的人最终能够结为夫妻。

examples.zh: 经历了这么多波折，有情人终成眷属，真为他们高兴。
examples.en: After so many twists, lovers have finally been united, and I'm truly happy for them.

examples.zh: 愿天下有情人终成眷属。
examples.en: May all lovers in the world be united in the end.

usage.en: Common in wedding wishes and romantic stories; often completed as 愿天下有情人终成眷属.
usage.zh: 常见于婚礼祝福与爱情故事，常说“愿天下有情人终成眷属”。

pinyin: huì kū de hái zi yǒu nǎi chī
literal: can · cry · 's · child · has · milk · eat
natural: The child who cries gets the milk

meaning.en: Those who speak up and make a fuss are the ones who get attention and resources.
meaning.zh: 会争取、会表达的人更容易得到好处。

equivalents: The squeaky wheel gets the grease
He who cries loudest gets fed

examples.zh: 会哭的孩子有奶吃，你不开口，领导怎么知道你想要什么？
examples.en: The squeaky wheel gets the grease; if you don't speak up, how will the boss know what you want?

examples.zh: 会哭的孩子有奶吃，他总能争取到最好的资源。
examples.en: The squeaky wheel gets the grease, and he always manages to win the best resources.

usage.en: Can be advice (speak up) or complaint (unfairness). Variants end 有糖吃 (gets sweets).
usage.zh: 可作建议（要敢于争取），也可作抱怨（有失公平）。

text: 钱不是万能的，但没有钱是万万不能的
pinyin: qián bú shì wàn néng de, dàn méi yǒu qián shì wàn wàn bù néng de
variants: 钱不是万能的，没钱是万万不能的
literal: money · not · is · all-powerful, but · without · money · is · absolutely · not · possible
natural: Money isn't everything, but you absolutely can't do without it

meaning.en: Money cannot solve every problem, but life is very hard without it.
meaning.zh: 钱不能解决所有问题，但没有钱什么事都办不成。

equivalents: Money isn't everything, but it's something
Money makes the world go round

examples.zh: 钱不是万能的，但没有钱是万万不能的，所以我要努力工作。
examples.en: Money isn't everything, but we can't do without it, so I must work hard.

examples.zh: 钱不是万能的，但没有钱是万万不能的，这是现实。
examples.en: Money isn't all-powerful but you can't live without it; that's reality.

usage.en: A realistic, slightly wry remark; often said in full. The second clause is sometimes shortened to 没钱万万不能.
usage.zh: 带现实和无奈的口吻，常整句引用。

pinyin: yī wén qián nán dǎo yīng xióng hàn
literal: one · coin · money · stump · hero · fellow
natural: A single coin can stump a hero

meaning.en: Even a strong, capable person can be brought to a standstill by lack of money.
meaning.zh: 再有本事的人，缺钱的时候也会一筹莫展。

equivalents: A man without money is like a ship without sails
Poverty is no vice but it's no virtue

examples.zh: 一文钱难倒英雄汉，他创业时差几万块周转不开。
examples.en: A penny can stump a hero; when he started his business he was a few thousand short of keeping it going.

examples.zh: 一文钱难倒英雄汉，别小看钱的作用。
examples.en: One coin can stop a hero in his tracks, so don't underestimate the power of money.

usage.en: Used of capable people stuck for cash. 一分钱 is a modern wording.
usage.zh: 用于有能力却缺钱的人；“一分钱”是较现代的说法。

text: 君子坦荡荡，小人长戚戚
pinyin: jūn zǐ tǎn dàng dàng, xiǎo rén cháng qī qī
literal: gentleman · open · wide · wide, petty person · always · anxious · anxious
natural: The gentleman is calm and open; the petty man is always anxious

meaning.en: A person of good character is relaxed and carefree; a mean-minded person is forever worried and full of anxiety.
meaning.zh: 品德高尚的人心胸宽广、坦然自在；心胸狭窄的人总是忧愁烦恼。

equivalents: A clear conscience is a soft pillow
A good conscience is a continual feast

examples.zh: 君子坦荡荡，小人长戚戚，他心里没鬼，自然睡得安稳。
examples.en: The gentleman is open and the small-minded man full of anxiety; with a clear conscience he naturally sleeps soundly.

examples.zh: 老师在作文里引用了“君子坦荡荡，小人长戚戚”。
examples.en: The teacher quoted 'The gentleman is at ease, the petty man is forever uneasy' in the essay.

story.en: Confucius contrasts the gentleman, who is composed because he has nothing to hide, with the petty man, who is always fretting over gain and loss.
story.zh: 《论语·述而》：“子曰：君子坦荡荡，小人长戚戚。”孔子以此区分君子与小人的心境。

usage.en: Quoted in essays and speeches about character. Formal and literary.
usage.zh: 常见于作文、演讲，谈论品格，语体较书面。

text: 宁得罪君子，不得罪小人
pinyin: nìng dé zuì jūn zǐ, bù dé zuì xiǎo rén
variants: 宁可得罪君子，不可得罪小人
literal: rather · offend · gentleman, not · offend · petty person
natural: Better to offend a gentleman than a petty man

meaning.en: A gentleman will forgive an offence, but a petty man will hold a grudge and take revenge, so avoid offending the latter.
meaning.zh: 君子大度，不会记仇；小人心胸狭窄，会报复，所以宁可得罪前者。

equivalents: Better to deal with a gentleman than a rogue

examples.zh: 宁得罪君子，不得罪小人，这个人心眼小，别惹他。
examples.en: Better to offend a gentleman than a petty man; he's narrow-minded, so don't cross him.

examples.zh: 有人说宁得罪君子，不得罪小人，我觉得这是处世的无奈。
examples.en: Some say you should rather offend a gentleman than a mean person; I think that is a sad way of getting along.

usage.en: Worldly-wise rather than noble; some people reject it as cynical.
usage.zh: 带处世的圆滑，也有人认为这话太世故。

pinyin: dī shuǐ zhī ēn, dāng yǒng quán xiāng bào
literal: drop · water · 's · kindness, should · gushing · spring · repay
natural: Repay a drop of kindness with a gushing spring

meaning.en: Even a small favour should be repaid many times over.
meaning.zh: 别人给的一点点恩惠，也要加倍报答。

examples.zh: 滴水之恩，当涌泉相报，我永远不会忘记您的帮助。
examples.en: A drop of kindness should be repaid with a spring; I'll never forget your help.

examples.zh: 滴水之恩，当涌泉相报，他每年都回来看望恩师。
examples.en: A small favour deserves a generous return, and he visits his old teacher every year.

usage.en: Used when expressing deep gratitude; formal and warm. Often shortened to 滴水之恩，涌泉相报.
usage.zh: 用于表达深切感恩，语气郑重温暖；也说“滴水之恩，涌泉相报”。

pinyin: yuān jiā yí jiě bù yí jié
literal: enemy · should · untie · not · should · tie
natural: Enmities should be untied, not knotted

meaning.en: It is better to settle a quarrel than to deepen the enmity.
meaning.zh: 仇怨应该化解，不应加深。

examples.zh: 冤家宜解不宜结，我们坐下来好好谈谈吧。
examples.en: Enmities are better settled than made, so let's sit down and talk it through.

examples.zh: 两家为一点小事闹僵了，邻居劝他们冤家宜解不宜结。
examples.en: The two families fell out over a trifle, and the neighbours urged them to make peace.

usage.en: Advice for reconciliation, often said by a peacemaker. The pun on 结 (knot/form) is deliberate.
usage.zh: 多用于劝和；“结”既是打结，也是结下仇怨。

pinyin: shǎo yī shì bù rú wú yī shì
literal: fewer · one · matter · not as good as · none · one · matter
natural: One matter fewer is not as good as none

meaning.en: Avoid getting involved in trouble; keep out of things that don't concern you.
meaning.zh: 能不惹麻烦就不惹麻烦，不要多管闲事。

examples.zh: 多一事不如少一事，少一事不如无一事，别去惹他了。
examples.en: Better to have fewer troubles than more, and none is best; don't provoke him.

examples.zh: 少一事不如无一事，我们还是别掺和他们的家务事。
examples.en: Keep out of trouble; let's not get involved in their family matters.

usage.en: Often paired with 多一事不如少一事. Can sound cautious or timid; sometimes used to criticise indifference.
usage.zh: 常与“多一事不如少一事”连用，既有谨慎之意，也可批评明哲保身。

pinyin: luó bo qīng cài, gè yǒu suǒ ài
literal: radish · greens, each · has · what · loves
natural: Radishes and greens, each to their own taste

meaning.en: People have different tastes, so there is no point arguing over preferences.
meaning.zh: 每个人喜好不同，无须争论。

equivalents: One man's meat is another man's poison

examples.zh: 萝卜青菜，各有所爱，你喜欢咸豆花，我喜欢甜的。
examples.en: Each to their own taste: you like salty tofu pudding, I like sweet.

examples.zh: 萝卜青菜，各有所爱，不用硬要大家都喜欢。
examples.en: Everyone has their own preferences, so don't insist that everybody likes it.

usage.en: A tolerant, light-hearted way of ending a debate about taste.
usage.zh: 用于对口味爱好不再争论，语气宽容轻松。

pinyin: yáo yán zhǐ yú zhì zhě
literal: rumour · stop · at · wise · person
natural: Rumours stop with the wise

meaning.en: A sensible person does not pass on or believe rumours, so the rumour dies with them.
meaning.zh: 聪明理智的人不会轻信、传播谣言，谣言到他那里就终止了。

equivalents: A wise man ends a rumour

examples.zh: 谣言止于智者，大家不要转发没有来源的消息。
examples.en: Rumours stop with the wise, so please don't forward unverified messages.

examples.zh: 面对网上的传言，我们要做到谣言止于智者。
examples.en: Faced with online rumours, we should let them end with us.

usage.en: Common in news, public notices and online campaigns against misinformation. Derived from 流言止于智者.
usage.zh: 常见于新闻、公告和网络辟谣；源自“流言止于智者”。

pinyin: shuō de róng yì zuò de nán
literal: say · -ly · easy · do · -ly · hard
natural: Easy to say, hard to do

meaning.en: It is much easier to talk about something than to actually do it.
meaning.zh: 说起来轻松，真做起来却很困难。

examples.zh: 你说得容易做得难，你来试试看。
examples.en: It's easier said than done; you try it.

examples.zh: 减肥说得容易做得难，我已经失败三次了。
examples.en: Losing weight is easier said than done; I've failed three times already.

usage.en: A common retort to someone who gives easy advice. Also 说起来容易，做起来难.
usage.zh: 常用来回应别人轻飘飘的建议；也说“说起来容易，做起来难”。

pinyin: kǒu shuō wú píng, lì zì wéi jù
literal: mouth · say · no · proof, set up · writing · as · evidence
natural: Spoken words prove nothing; put it in writing

meaning.en: A verbal promise is not reliable evidence, so agreements should be put in writing.
meaning.zh: 口头承诺没有凭证，要立下字据作为依据。

equivalents: An oral agreement isn't worth the paper it's not written on

examples.zh: 口说无凭，立字为据，咱们还是签份合同吧。
examples.en: A spoken word proves nothing, so let's sign a contract.

examples.zh: 借钱要写借条，口说无凭，立字为据。
examples.en: Write an IOU when you lend money, because words alone are no proof.

usage.en: Used in deals, loans and agreements. Slightly formal; also on traditional contracts.
usage.zh: 多用于交易、借贷和协议场合，较正式，传统契约中也常见。

pinyin: yīng xióng bú pà chū shēn dī
literal: hero · not · fear · origin · low
natural: Heroes don't fear humble origins

meaning.en: Humble birth is no obstacle to success; real ability matters more than background.
meaning.zh: 出身低微不妨碍成就大业，关键在于本事和志气。

equivalents: Every man is the architect of his own fortune

examples.zh: 英雄不怕出身低，他从农村走出来，成了行业领袖。
examples.en: Heroes don't fear humble origins; he came from the countryside and became an industry leader.

examples.zh: 英雄不怕出身低，只要肯努力，一样能出人头地。
examples.en: A low start is no obstacle; with hard work anyone can get ahead.

usage.en: Encouraging; often used for self-made people and in motivational speeches.
usage.zh: 带鼓励意味，常用于白手起家的人和励志场合。

pinyin: yī shān gèng bǐ yī shān gāo
literal: one · mountain · even · than · one · mountain · high
natural: Each mountain is higher than the last

meaning.en: There is always someone better; one should stay humble.
meaning.zh: 总有人比你更强，要保持谦虚。

examples.zh: 比赛才知道，一山更比一山高，我还差得远。
examples.en: Only in the competition did I see that there is always someone better; I'm far from the top.

examples.zh: 别骄傲，一山更比一山高。
examples.en: Don't be proud; there's always someone better.

usage.en: A warning against arrogance. Often followed by 强中更有强中手.
usage.zh: 用于告诫人不要骄傲，常接“强中更有强中手”。

pinyin: shān wài yǒu shān, tiān wài yǒu tiān
literal: mountain · beyond · there is · mountain, sky · beyond · there is · sky
natural: There are mountains beyond the mountains, and a sky beyond the sky

meaning.en: There is always someone or something better than you; stay modest and keep learning.
meaning.zh: 永远有更高的境界和更强的人，要谦虚进取。

examples.zh: 出国后我才明白山外有山，天外有天。
examples.en: After going abroad I understood that there are always better people beyond one's horizon.

examples.zh: 山外有山，天外有天，千万不要自满。
examples.en: Don't be complacent; there's always someone better out there.

usage.en: The second half is often stated as 人外有人; forms with the halves swapped are common.
usage.zh: 后半句常作“人外有人”，前后半句也常对调。
